import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(data):
    df = pd.DataFrame(data)

    # Handle empty input gracefully
    if df.empty:
        result = df.copy()
        result["Average"] = pd.Series(dtype=float)
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
        ax.set_title("Average of Normalized Rows")
        ax.set_xlabel("Row")
        ax.set_ylabel("Average")
        return result, ax

    # Keep numeric columns for MinMax scaling
    numeric_df = df.select_dtypes(include="number")

    # If no numeric columns are present, try coercing values to numeric
    if numeric_df.shape[1] == 0:
        numeric_df = df.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

    if numeric_df.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input data must contain at least one numeric column.")

    # Replace missing values with column means to allow scaling
    if numeric_df.isnull().any().any():
        numeric_df = numeric_df.fillna(numeric_df.mean(numeric_only=True))

    scaler = MinMaxScaler()
    scaled_values = scaler.fit_transform(numeric_df)

    result = pd.DataFrame(scaled_values, columns=numeric_df.columns, index=df.index)
    result["Average"] = result.mean(axis=1)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(6, len(result) * 0.5), 4))
    ax.bar(range(len(result)), result["Average"], color="steelblue")
    ax.set_title("Average of Normalized Rows")
    ax.set_xlabel("Row")
    ax.set_ylabel("Average")
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(result)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(result.index, rotation=45, ha="right")
    plt.tight_layout()

    return result, ax
